items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were at that time working on the United States premiere of a piece by Norman Dello Joio called The Ruby.

ctx.x: . . . Metropolitan Opera Orchestra. I really had met him prior to that, because he came out to Indiana University when the Metropolitan Opera used to tour. We would do a performance for them of whatever opera we were working on. We were at that time working on the United States premiere of a piece by Norman Dello Joio called The Ruby.
